mapper.select: select lsbs.${column} from logc_stock_business_switch lsbs INNER JOIN logc_stock_info lsi ON lsbs.stock_code = lsi.stock_code and lsi.biz_org_code = lsbs.biz_org_code where lsbs.is_delete = 0 and lsbs.stock_code = #{stockCode} and (lsi.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} or lsi.id in (select stock_id from logc_stock_org_auth where biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode}))

select lsi.id, lsi.stock_code, lsi.stock_name, lsi.is_enable,lwi.warehouse_code,lwi.warehouse_name, lsi.is_delete,lsi.biz_org_code,lsi.org_code from logc_stock_info lsi inner join logc_warehouse_info lwi on lwi.id = lsi.warehouse_id and lwi.is_delete=0 where lsi.is_delete=0 and lsi.stock_code=#{stockCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by lsi.is_delete limit 1
